framework_name: Colorado SB 24-205 (Consumer Protections for Artificial Intelligence)
scope_note: This mapping explains which statutory deployer duty each record category evidences. It supports an impact assessment and audit readiness; it is not a legal compliance determination.

mappings.duty: Human review protocols and decision logs
mappings.how: Each consequential decision carries the reviewer identity, review outcome, timestamp, and a tamper-evident signature.
Covenant-blocked actions are contemporaneous proof that guardrails operated and were enforced.
Approval records show a named human authorized each gated decision before it took effect, with a signed, timestamped receipt.
HMAC chain plus per-record public-key receipts prove records were not modified after the fact.
Every consequential agent step (profile reads, drafts, LLM calls) is recorded in order with a policy decision attached, documenting how the system actually operated during the covered period.
Deployer-supplied. AIR deliberately records no protected-class attributes; the deployer's own outcome analysis ships under attachments/ and the manifest marks this duty as deployer-supplied.
